sec.title: Batch 59 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 59 resolves 24 historic radio broadcasts across classic American industrial biographical dramas, regional conservation and country Western musical shows, and 1970s satirical serials: 8 foundational episodes from the 1939 docudrama series ***Captains of Industry*** (chronicling John D. Rockefeller, Milton Hershey, Marshall Field, P.T. Barnum, Mark Hanna, the Studebaker Brothers, John H. Patterson of NCR, and Frank A. Vanderlip), 8 broadcast conservation programs from the ***Texas Forest Service / US Forest Service*** (1950–1952, starring The Sons of the Pioneers as The Singing Woodsman, Jelly Elliott and the Three Knotheads, and Bill Scott, Forest Ranger), and 8 episodes of the satirical radio serial ***The Karl Morgan Adventures*** (starring Monte Kessinger and Harriet Greer, 1972).
